text: {"lessons":["I should make trades from a clear, forward-looking thesis and avoid reacting to short-term price moves; selling Stock B at a loss and then buying it back calls for more discipline.","I should set position sizes and risk limits before buying, so a few losing holdings do not unduly damage the account.","I should judge decisions by their expected long-run merits, not by my average cost or the urge to recover a loss, and review whether my approach is actually outperforming the market."]}
